stories.title: Officials investigating fatal crash on Highway 169 near Shakopee
stories.summary: The crash occurred on northbound Highway 169 between Minnesota 13 and Minnesota 101, but no other details were provided.

stories.title: Fed report reveals more positives for the economy, though many might not feel it
stories.summary: A new Beige Book released by the Federal Reserve found growth across the US and our region, but it's largely driven by AI expansion and wealthy consumers.

stories.title: Missing teen boy, Columbia Height PD ask for public help
stories.summary: Authorities believe he may be in or traveling to New York.

stories.title: Man charged with murder in Minnetonka stabbing death
stories.summary: Prosecutors accused Ryan Loftus of second-degree murder after one of the victim's children found her unconscious and bleeding in her front yard on Nov. 20.

stories.title: Hmong New Year set to bring crowds to St. Paul
stories.summary: The gathering celebrates the end of harvest season and community blessings.

stories.title: Kowalski's recalls stuffing purchased before Thanksgiving
stories.summary: The stuffing prepared by a third-party vendor for Thanksgiving meals did not meet the grocery store's food safety standards.

stories.title: Prior Lake mosque fire ruled accidental
stories.summary: The Masjid Hamza Al-Mahmood Foundation was significantly damaged in the blaze in December of 2025.

stories.title: Twin Cities-area ski hills make their own winter as cold weather returns
stories.summary: Trollhaugen and Wild Mountain plan to reopen Wednesday, while other metro ski hills take advantage of colder temperatures to make snow.

stories.title: The ‘Ultimate Rally’ for a south Minneapolis hospice patient
stories.summary: Facing a terminal diagnosis, the University of Minnesota Marching Band helped knock off an item of a south Minneapolis woman’s bucket list.

stories.title: Pilgrim's Pride facing more than $123K in fines after employee's death in June
stories.summary: A 29-year-old employee died after being pinned underneath equipment in the loading dock at the Cold Spring facility.

stories.title: Mayo Clinic to pay more than $900K in back wages to some employees
stories.summary: As part of the settlement, Mayo Clinic will pay employees $906,088.88 in back wages and also agreed to policy changes, including no longer rounding time for workers.

stories.title: H Mart plans to open a new location in Midway Marketplace
stories.summary: The country's largest Asian grocery chain will anchor the shopping plaza where Cub Foods closed in 2025.
